title_vi: Học AWS từ đâu: nhóm dịch vụ nền tảng, dữ liệu, nhắn tin và vận hành

claims.claim_vi: The source text says AWS evolved since 2006 from simple offerings like S3 and EC2 to over 200 services used by hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries; that the attached illustration is a starting point and quick reference with foundational services and advanced ones for serverless, DevOps and machine learning. The text names no other service.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: EC2 rents virtual servers, S3 stores objects, VPC is a private network, IAM controls identities and permissions, RDS runs managed relational databases, DynamoDB stores key-value data, SQS is a queue, SNS fans out notifications, Lambda runs code on events, CloudWatch collects metrics and logs and sets alarms, CloudFormation describes infrastructure as code.
claims.verified_by: Author's general knowledge; AWS documentation was not opened in this session. The services listed are not read from the source image.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung thẻ dịch vụ (nền tảng; dữ liệu và nhắn tin) và một khung ghi chú bài tập.
source_deviations: The source is a short introduction plus a roadmap image; the lesson did not read the image and does not copy it, so the list of services is the author's own and may differ from the image.
The numbers 2006, 200+ services and 190 countries come from the source text and were not re-checked against AWS today.
The lesson adds a group map and a needs-to-service exercise; there is no experiment because nothing computable was claimed.
